svg.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts routing, animated
svg.desc: Six tokens pass through a router that picks the top 2 of 8 routed experts (syntax, code, math, Deutsch, vision, semantics, memes, hardware) while a shared expert processes every token; outputs are combined as S(x) plus the gate-weighted sum, and the load bars show balanced expert usage.

g.text: 02 · EVERY NEURON HAS A DIFFERENT OPINION
▬ bar under each expert = load so far

text.tspan: every expert got work · bias-adjusted routing, no auxiliary loss
